coverage.notes: Source: WDFW game harvest reports (wdfw.wa.gov/hunting/management/game-harvest), one HTML report page per year and report, built from mandatory hunter reports. Per GMU (id as published, e.g. '101', '382') and per WDFW district: 'General + permit (all weapons)' = WDFW 'combined general and special permits' table (harvest only); 'General season total' and Archery / Modern Firearm (method rifle) / Muzzleloader / Multiple Weapons (method other) '(general)' rows = WDFW general season table with hunters, hunter success, hunter days as published (GMU 'Totals' rows: WDFW prints n/a for hunters, so null); 'Special permits (all)' = WDFW special permit table by GMU (harvest only). Antlered/antlerless counts and antler point classes are in each row note exactly as published (harvestMale/harvestFemale are not filled because antlerless is not the same as female). Special permit hunts: hunt = WDFW 4-digit hunt number, unit = WDFW hunt name as published (hunt areas are not GMU ids), licenses = permits issued, applicants and reports returned in the note. Statewide rows come from WDFW's statewide pages. Hunters are not additive across GMUs. Cross-checks: GMU per-weapon sums equal WDFW statewide archery/modern firearm/muzzleloader figures (elk every year; deer 2020-2023 exactly, 2024-2025 within 10 per weapon); WDFW's statewide totals exclude multiple weapons tag holders (published separately) while GMU totals include them, so GMU sums exceed the statewide total by that amount. A few WDFW district totals do not equal the sum of the GMU rows WDFW lists under them (elk combined 2020 District 5, 2021 District 6, 2022 District 5 printed as 0; deer District 13 in 2024-2025 printed 2-16 higher); those district rows keep WDFW's printed figure and say so in the note. Rows where WDFW printed n/a in every cell are omitted. Three tiny multiple-weapons rows where WDFW prints success above 100% keep that figure in the note with successPct null.

IMPORTANT: WDFW publishes GMU, district and statewide deer harvest for all deer species combined (mule deer, white-tailed deer and black-tailed deer); those rows are identical in mule-deer.json and whitetail.json, so never add the two files. Special permit hunts that are white-tailed only (by WDFW hunt name or the pamphlet's legal-deer column) are only in whitetail.json; hunts named or listed as mule deer / black-tailed only, and hunts outside the white-tailed range, are only in mule-deer.json; other eastern hunts are in both files. Black-tailed deer (western Washington, GMUs 400-699) have no separate key and are inside the mule-deer rows. The 186 '9xxx' land-manager access hunts in the 2021 deer report (all with 0 hunters and 0 harvest, 42 of them elk hunts) are omitted. Combined rows still include mule deer taken in those GMUs. Washington has no pronghorn hunting season; WDFW publishes no pronghorn harvest.

Source: WDFW moose special permit harvest reports, one row per permit hunt (hunt = WDFW hunt number 8000-8027, unit = WDFW hunt name as published, whitespace collapsed; 2020 names use an en dash, e.g. 'Douglas A – Early'). Hunters, harvest, males/females killed, hunter days and hunter success as published; licenses = permits issued; applicants, quota, reports returned and days/kill in the note. Moose is permit-only in Washington; no statewide row is published.

Source: WDFW black bear harvest reports. GMU rows = general (fall) season by GMU with male/female harvest, hunters, success, hunter days as published. BMU/BBMU rows = WDFW statewide table by bear management unit (2020-2024 'BMU 1'-'BMU 9'; for license year 2025 WDFW changed to 14 Black Bear Management Units, 'BBMU 1'-'BBMU 14', with different GMU membership, so BMU and BBMU rows are not comparable). Statewide rows: general season, spring permit hunt and WDFW 'Recreational Harvest Total'. Spring bear permit hunts were reported for 2020 and 2021 (21 hunts each, hunt = WDFW hunt number 7000-7020, unit = GMU in the WDFW 'Hunt Area' column); WDFW shows 0 spring permit harvest for 2022-2025 and publishes no spring hunt page for those years. Cross-check: GMU sums equal WDFW's statewide general season harvest every year (e.g. 2024: 1,793).

Source: WDFW bighorn sheep special permit harvest reports, one row per permit hunt. hunt = WDFW hunt number (5000-5031; WDFW re-numbers hunts between years, so compare by unit, not hunt number). unit = WDFW sheep unit id ('7', '4A', ...) or 'GMU 169'/'GMU 172' where WDFW names a GMU; unitName = hunt name as published (asterisks are WDFW's own marks; the report page does not explain them). Hunters, harvest, hunter days, success as published; licenses = permits issued; applicants, quota, reports returned in the note. Sex of harvest is not published in the sheep report.

Source: WDFW mountain goat special permit harvest reports, one row per permit hunt. hunt = WDFW hunt number, unit = WDFW mountain goat unit id ('3-6', '5-4', ...), unitName = hunt name as published. Hunters, harvest, males/females killed, hunter days, success as published; licenses = permits issued; applicants and quota in the note. WDFW lists 12 hunts for 2020, 15 for 2021, 12 for 2022, 9 for 2023-2024 and 5 for 2025.

Source: WDFW statewide cougar harvest statistics, one page per year. Rows are WDFW's 'General Hunting' known mortalities by GMU, by cougar management unit (2020-2024 'CMU n'; for 2025 WDFW changed to Cougar Hunt Management Units 'CHMU n' with different GMU membership) and statewide, with male/female as published and unknown-sex count in the note. WDFW does not publish cougar hunter numbers or success, so hunters/successPct are null. Conflict/depredation and other mortalities (roadkill, poaching, etc.) published by WDFW are not hunting harvest and are not included. WDFW: statistics are 'based on the best available data at the time of publication and are subject to change'. Cross-check: GMU sums equal the statewide general season figure every year.

Source: WDFW statewide turkey harvest statistics. WDFW publishes turkey harvest by Population Management Unit (unit 'P10'...'P50' with WDFW PMU name) and season (methodLabel 'Spring season' / 'Fall season'), with hunters, success and hunter days, plus a statewide 'Permit Hunts' harvest and statewide 'Total'. No GMU-level turkey harvest is published. Cross-check: PMU sums + permit hunts equal WDFW's statewide total every year (e.g. 2024: 8,885). Seasons WDFW did not list for a PMU in a year (e.g. P20 fall 2020) are absent, not zero.
